title: Concept: Conan requirement declared as a version range
description: conanfile.txt declares a `[version range]` requirement, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `[version range]` requirement.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through conanfile.txt (conan).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `[version range]` requirement.
